New plan: 

I got stuck in a loop between the Dining room, Guest room, and Bathroom, repeatedly going north and then south. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to keep visiting the same rooms instead of exploring new ones. Next time, I will make sure to keep track of the rooms I have visited and avoid revisiting them. I will also try to explore new rooms by taking a new direction from the current room, instead of just going back and forth between the same rooms. For example, if I am in the Guest room and I have already visited the Dining room and Bathroom, I will try to go east to explore the Recreation room or Attic, instead of going south to the Dining room again.
